title: How a Godly Man Treats His Body Like It Isn't Just His to Wreck
caption:
A godly man's body isn't his to wreck.

1 Corinthians 6:19 calls it a temple, not a project you get to later. Every skipped workout, every 2 a.m. plate of nothing that helps, adds up in a ledger you'll eventually have to read.

Sleep is a discipline, not a luxury. What you put in your mouth is a spiritual decision, gluttony just never gets preached like lust does. Move like it isn't disposable. You don't need a gym membership to prove you believe your body matters. You need to stop treating it like scenery.
